hardware.candidate_role: USB/display signer Unicode review signing-gate smoke
hardware.tested_state: rebuilt and reflashed after adding unicode_review_rendering to the runtime signing-readiness gate

procedure: Sourced /Users/vincenzo/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh in the same shell used for build, flash, and smoke.
Built firmware revision d2387b1 with ESP-IDF v5.5.4; the app binary size was 0x8eb10 bytes with 0x714f0 bytes free.
Flashed the firmware to /dev/cu.usbmodem1101 and verified image hashes during the ESP-IDF flash operation.
Ran make IDF_PORT=/dev/cu.usbmodem1101 idf-smoke-capabilities after the flash.
expected_result: The firmware should build, flash cleanly, expose unicode_review_rendering as a missing signing-readiness gate through get_signing_status, keep the serial protocol responsive, reject malformed or unsafe inputs deterministically, and preserve signing_disabled.
observed_result: The flash completed successfully with image hashes verified. The post-flash capability smoke passed with 39 verified exchanges, 9 response frames, and 30 expected rejection frames.
limitations: This report validates the disabled-signing runtime signing-readiness diagnostic and post-flash serial protocol behavior only.
It is not a manual visual display inspection, physical button approval test, camera test, QR flow test, key provisioning test, storage test, or real signing test.

The run does not validate production trusted-display acceptance, full Unicode review rendering acceptance, production physical-control acceptance, secure boot, flash encryption, debug lock, companion signed-output verification for real signatures, or production signing readiness.
sign_event remains signing_disabled until every production signing gate is satisfied.
